project.name: PowerGIS Enterprise GIS Platform
project.architecture: Modular Pure White & Vibrant Color Utility Architecture (SSOT)
project.mission: Mission-critical electrical distribution GIS, SCADA integration, 8-stage breakdown ticketing, and RDSS capital works for Puducherry Union Territory

src/config/appConfig.ts.purpose: Application identity, regional enclaves (Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, Yanam), default coordinates, zoom levels, telemetry intervals, and security passwords.

src/config/themeConfig.ts.purpose: Design tokens, primary/accent/success/warning gradients, hex colors, role badges, getPriorityStyle(), and getStatusStyle() helper functions.

src/config/basemapConfig.ts.purpose: 8 Vibrant Color Basemaps (Google, OSM, Esri), default basemap ID (google_roadmap), URL templates, attributions, and category color badges.

src/config/rbacConfig.ts.purpose: 16 utility roles registry, hierarchy tiers, default jurisdictions, privilege tags, and granular permission flags.

src/config/workflowConfig.ts.purpose: 8-stage fault progression lifecycle, IEEE/JERC SLA allowed hours (4h, 8h, 24h, 72h), and 5-column work order Kanban board definitions.

src/config/navigationConfig.ts.purpose: Central routing table for 22 navigation tabs, icon components, role access arrays, color accents, and descriptions.

src/config/index.ts.purpose: Barrel export for all configuration files.
exports: * from appConfig, themeConfig, basemapConfig, rbacConfig, workflowConfig, navigationConfig

src/context/AuthContext.tsx.purpose: Zero-trust session state, active user profile, login, fast persona switcher, and role state management.

src/context/GISContext.tsx.purpose: Map state provider: current basemap, active layers, measurement tool (distance/area), region flyTo, selected asset, map bearing (0-360°), and rotation.

src/services/gisService.ts.purpose: GIS service bridge importing availableBasemaps and region coordinates from src/config.

src/services/authService.ts.purpose: Authentication, user credential validation, role permissions calculation, and jurisdiction lookup.

src/services/faultService.ts.purpose: 8-stage fault ticket CRUD, status progression, crew assignment, and distance calculation trigger.

src/services/scadaService.ts.purpose: IEC 60870-5-104 & Modbus telemetry simulator, Select-Before-Operate (SBO) breaker command dispatch, and alarm feed.

src/services/surveyService.ts.purpose: Contractor staging sandbox, multi-tier survey verification (JE check -> AE approval), and live GIS asset promotion.

src/services/assetService.ts.purpose: Electrical asset inventory search, filtering by region/voltage, and GIS spatial coordinate linking.

src/services/notificationService.ts.purpose: Role-based dashboard metrics, pending assignments, notifications feed, and read/unread state tracking.

src/services/dataExchangeService.ts.purpose: GeoJSON, CSV, and Shapefile import/export engine with schema validation and duplicate detection.

src/services/reliabilityService.ts.purpose: IEEE 1366 reliability indices calculation (SAIFI, SAIDI, CAIDI, and Energy Not Served).

src/services/riskService.ts.purpose: ISO 55000 asset risk scoring (Probability of Failure × Consequence of Failure) and action planning.

src/services/mockData.ts.purpose: Real-world Puducherry grid seed dataset: substations, 22kV/11kV feeders, DTRs, poles, smart meters, faults, work orders.

src/lib/geoUtils.ts.purpose: Haversine geodesic distance, polygon area, nearest pole/DT computation, feeder line projection, and coordinate rotation translation.

src/lib/offlineQueue.ts.purpose: IndexedDB / localStorage offline survey queue for field crews with auto-sync when online.

src/lib/supabase.ts.purpose: Supabase PostgreSQL / PostGIS 3.4 client initialization and real-time subscription channels.

gis.src/components/gis/MasterMap.tsx: Full-screen Leaflet GIS map with 360° canvas rotation, SVG single-line overlay, and attribute synchronization.
gis.src/components/gis/BasemapSwitcher.tsx: Multi-vendor colorful basemap launcher (Google Roadmap default, OSM, Esri).
gis.src/components/gis/LayerTree.tsx: Floating overlay switcher (Substations, HT/LT Feeders, DTRs, Poles, Smart Meters).
gis.src/components/gis/MapRotationControl.ts: Compass dial, angle slider (0-359°), cardinal presets, and North reset button.
gis.src/components/gis/MeasureTool.tsx: Interactive point-to-point distance and polygon area measuring tool.
gis.src/components/gis/MapAttributeDrawer.ts: Bottom synchronized asset attribute drawer with real-time flyTo and specs.

layout.src/components/layout/Header.tsx: UTC/IST operational clock, search bar, enclave switcher, notification bell, user switcher.
layout.src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: Vibrant collapsible navigation sidebar consuming NAVIGATION_ITEMS from src/config.
layout.src/components/layout/ScopeBanner.tsx: Persistent sticky HUD banner showing Active Identity, Jurisdiction Scope, and Privilege Tags.
layout.src/components/layout/MobileBottomNav.ts: Mobile bottom navigation bar for quick touch switching.

dashboard.src/components/dashboard/RoleBasedDashbo: Persona-scoped dashboard with statutory permission badges, KPI metrics, assignments, and quick actions.
dashboard.src/components/dashboard/DashboardAnalyt: Recharts visual analytics: 24h demand area curve, asset distribution donut, IEEE 1366 reliability bars, and feeder capacity gauges.

operations.src/components/faults/FaultList.tsx: 8-stage breakdown ticket management, live IEEE SLA countdown timers, and geodesic proximity box.
operations.src/components/workOrders/WorkOrderKanba: 5-column maintenance task Kanban board consuming WORK_ORDER_COLUMNS from src/config.
operations.src/components/scada/ScadaTelemetryDashb: IEC-104 telemetry, interactive substation SLD with Select-Before-Operate (SBO) remote breaker control.
operations.src/components/projects/CapitalProjectsR: RDSS capital works tracker with physical progress (%) vs financial expenditure (₹ Cr) milestones.
operations.src/components/surveys/ContractorPWA.tsx: Mobile field survey PWA interface with GPS capture and photo staging.
operations.src/components/surveys/SurveyApprovalQue: Multi-tier verification queue (JE check -> AE approval -> live GIS promotion).
operations.src/components/smartMeters/SmartMeterDas: AMI smart metering telecommunications, load profiles, and tamper detection.
operations.src/components/topology/NetworkTraceView: Network topology tracing: upstream to substation, downstream to consumers.
operations.src/components/safety/PermitToWorkManage: Digital Permit to Work (PTW) line clearance and earthing verification.
operations.src/components/risk/AssetRiskMatrix.tsx: ISO 55000 asset risk matrix (5x5 PoF vs CoF) and health index ranking.
operations.src/components/warranties/WarrantyRegist: Asset warranty expiration tracker and vendor claims management.
operations.src/components/outages/OutageManager.tsx: Power outage management and IEEE 1366 reliability calculation.
operations.src/components/preventive/MaintenanceSch: Preventive maintenance scheduler and checklist audit.
operations.src/components/dtLoading/DTLoadingAnalyt: Distribution transformer load curves and phase imbalance analyzer.
operations.src/components/stores/StoresInventory.ts: Utility materials inventory, critical spares, and scrap tracking.
operations.src/components/disaster/DisasterResponse: Cyclone and flood emergency response planning and restoration cell.
operations.src/components/admin/AdminControlPanel.t: User management, role assignment, and zero-trust RLS security administration.
operations.src/components/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Official staff login and 1-click persona switcher.
